regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-horse leadership: Banks (rank 1, eligible, crowded) just ahead of Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, eligible, crowded), with only 4 of 22 themes passing the trend gate and absorption very low at 0.32 (no one-narrative). emerging_watch: Watching Robotics & Automation (unscorable, rank 17, score -0.342): if its breadth (currently 0.182) expands above 0.5 AND it clears the trend gate to eligible, that would be a confirmed handoff candidate worth re-scoring — until then it is only an early-stages breadth repair, not a call.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks hold the highest rank and eligibility, with strong breadth (0.889) and a durability bar of 0.73 — the most cohesive leadership in the ranks. The lean rests on the trend-gate eligibility plus breadth/durability legs as a focus lens, not on momentum as alpha. Crowding (z 1.78) is noted only as a size-down caution, not a reason to avoid.
theses.dissent: This market's own history shows the trend gate did not cut drawdown here (gate_helps=false), and Banks are crowded — mean-reverting A-share tape could whipsaw the leader hard.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF (512800.SS) prints a new 20-day relative low versus CSI 300 within the 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the challenger, a near-tie with Banks (margin 0.01), eligible and with reasonable breadth (0.643) behind the leader. Given the rotation margin is effectively nil, the two top names represent the only eligible leadership left standing; the lean is a conditional overweight on the challenger leg, not a handoff call.
theses.dissent: The detector explicitly forbids predicting the next narrative; a challenger near-tie is coincident, not a validated handoff, and crowded Pharma can mean-revert sharply on policy headlines.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO ETF (159992.SZ) lags the Banks ETF (512800.SS) by more than 5% over the 20-trading-day window.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Rank 3 but NOT eligible (fails the trend gate) and with near-zero breadth (0.059). Despite a 'trend' hurst tag, the gate did not clear it, and on a market where the gate already has no drawdown edge, an ineligible, narrow-breadth tech theme is a stay-out under the trend-gate discipline.
theses.dissent: AI Compute is the only 'trend' hurst-tagged name in the top three and is not crowded (z -0.66) — a sharp policy or order-flow catalyst could flip it eligible fast.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics ETF (515000.SS) regains trend-gate eligibility and clears breadth above 0.3 within the 20 trading days.
